description: This Java test class 'LoanCOBCatchUpInstanceModeIntegrationTest' contains integration tests for the Loan COB Catch Up functionality within the Apache Fineract project. It verifies behavior under different instance modes and configurations, focusing on batch processing modes, read-only modes, and scheduler operations.

classes.name: LoanCOBCatchUpInstanceModeIntegrationTest
classes.description: Integration test class for testing the Loan COB Catch Up feature under different instance modes, verifying correct behavior when in batch manager mode, read-only mode, and during scheduler operations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including REST setup, helpers, and global configurations before each test.

methods.name: testLoanCOBCatchUpWorksWhenInBatchManagerMode
methods.description: Tests that the Loan COB Catch Up executes successfully when the system is in batch manager mode.

methods.name: testLoanCOBCatchUpDoesNotWorksWhenNotInBatchManagerMode
methods.description: Ensures that the Loan COB Catch Up fails with a 405 error when not in batch manager mode.

methods.name: testLoanCOBCatchUpGetStatusWorksWhenInBatchManagerMode
methods.description: Verifies that fetching the COB catch-up status works when in batch manager mode.

methods.name: testLoanCOBCatchUpGetStatusDoesNotWorksWhenNotInBatchManagerMode
methods.description: Checks that fetching the COB catch-up status fails with a 405 error outside batch manager mode.

methods.name: testLoanCOBCatchUpOtherGetApisWorksWhenInBatchManagerAndReadMode
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the oldest COB processed loan when in batch manager mode with read-only enabled.

methods.name: testLoanCOBCatchUpOtherGetApisWorksWhenInReadOnlyMode
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the oldest COB processed loan in read-only mode.

methods.name: testSchedulerWorksWhenInBatchManagerMode
methods.description: Verifies that scheduler can be disabled when in batch manager mode.

methods.name: testSchedulerDoesNotWorksWhenNotInBatchManagerMode
methods.description: Ensures scheduler update operation fails with a 405 error when not in batch manager mode.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Restores global configuration and scheduler state after each test.
